claude_proposed_widenings.name: rest_configured_passive
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fiendish Resilience is not activated during play. It is a persistent passive whose damage-type choice is made at rest time and stays in effect indefinitely until replaced. The sole existing class-feature family (activation) mandates use_count + activationCost (free | bonus_action). Neither applies: no uses are consumed, and there is no combat-turn cost. A new family is needed — something like 'rest_configured_passive' — to express 'persistent effect whose parameters are chosen each time the player finishes a qualifying rest.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one damage type, other than Force, whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest. You have Resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureEffect only contains grant_extra_action and heal_hp. The v4 atom inventory includes grant_resistance, but no corresponding surface variant exists for class features. Even if the structural family gap were resolved, a GrantResistanceEffect variant (specifying which damage type, or that the type is chosen at rest) would be required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.
